_comment: Texas Instruments FY2025 (data/edgar/TXN.json) plus illustrative market inputs (risk-free = 10yr UST, ERP = Damodaran implied ERP, beta = illustrative for a cyclical analog semiconductor company). Coverage-based synthetic rating (ebit/interest_expense) replaces a real credit rating, same convention as examples/wacc_stld.json/wacc_alk.json -- TXN's real FY2025 interest coverage (EBIT $6,023M vs interest expense $543M, ~11x) is strong, unlike the airline check's distressed coverage.
